name: opencode-obsidian
description: Obsidian Vault integration with local RAG capabilities and custom templates
instructions: Use these tools to interact with the user's Obsidian vault. You can capture notes, apply templates, search notes, manage daily notes, and use RAG to answer questions based on the notes. The system automatically detects Azure IDs, git tags, and categorizes content. Always check if a vault path is known; if not, ask the user to provide it or set the OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH environment variable.
